name: UserZoom
description_en:
UserZoom is a UX research platform currently documented within UserTesting’s official product and help sites. The legacy UserZoom homepage redirects to a page that explicitly identifies UserZoom, while its own study documentation remains distinguishable from UserTesting’s other products.

It supports research design, participant recruitment, moderated sessions and analysis. Product-specific method and installation requirements can be researched even though a current UserZoom cash price was not obtained.
description_zh:
UserZoom 是当前在 UserTesting 官方产品及帮助站点中有明确文档的 UX 研究平台。旧首页跳转到明确命名 UserZoom 的页面，其研究文档仍与 UserTesting 其他产品区分。

它支持研究设计、参与者招募、主持研究及分析。虽未获得当前 UserZoom 现金价格，仍可核对其具体方法和安装要求。

sections.title_en: Design, recruit, launch, analyze and share
sections.title_zh: 设计、招募、发布、分析与分享
sections.en: The official product page describes usability studies, surveys and information-architecture methods, recruitment through networks or your own audience, and transcripts, playback, notes, clips and charts. These are UserZoom product statements. They do not establish that a UserTesting Advanced/Ultimate contract includes an identical UserZoom package.
sections.zh: 官方产品页介绍可用性、问卷和信息架构方法，通过样本网络或自有人群招募，以及转录、回放、笔记、片段和图表。这些属于 UserZoom 产品说明，不证明 UserTesting Advanced/Ultimate 合同包含相同 UserZoom 组合。

sections.title_en: Open and structured interviews have different conditions
sections.title_zh: 开放与结构化访谈条件不同
sections.en: UserZoom help distinguishes an open conversation without tasks from a structured interview with a question/task sequence. The type cannot be switched after creation. Open interviews are documented across all UserZoom plans; structured interviews list Essentials, Professional, International and Premium. Desktop navigation tasks in structured interviews require the UserZoom Surveys extension. Open mobile-app interviews use UserZoom Live screen capture without embedding a testing SDK in the target app.
sections.zh: UserZoom 帮助区分无任务的开放对话与按问题任务序列开展的结构化访谈，创建后不能互换类型。开放访谈列为全部 UserZoom 套餐可用，结构化访谈列 Essentials、Professional、International 和 Premium。结构化桌面导航任务需 UserZoom Surveys 扩展；开放移动应用访谈通过 UserZoom Live 录屏，无需把测试 SDK 嵌入目标应用。

sections.title_en: Example: investigate a difficult account-settings task
sections.title_zh: 示例：研究难以完成的账户设置任务
sections.en: Prepare a prototype and a neutral task, then choose a structured study if comparable navigation evidence is needed. Pilot the participant install and access path before recruitment. Compare the recording, task result and participant explanation instead of accepting a chart alone. If unexpected concerns require free conversation, plan the interview method before creation rather than assuming you can switch it later. No study was launched here.
sections.zh: 准备原型和中性任务，如需可比导航证据，先选择结构化研究。正式招募前试点安装与访问链路，把录屏、任务结果及参与者解释对照，不能只看图表。若需要自由对话探索意外担忧，应在创建前选好访谈方式，不能假定以后可以切换。本文未发布研究。

sections.title_en: Scheduling and technical checks affect feasibility
sections.title_zh: 调度与技术检查影响研究可行性
sections.en: The moderated guide requires a live study before participants schedule, change or cancel a session. It allows screeners with scheduled moderated studies and excludes them from unscheduled moderated studies. The separate Tech Check validates audio, microphone, camera and network; participant and moderator checks differ. Diagnose permissions, connectivity and approved network access before assuming a participant refusal is a usability finding.
sections.zh: 主持研究指南要求研究先上线，参与者才能预约、更改或取消场次。定时主持研究可含筛选题，非预约主持研究不能含筛选题。独立 Tech Check 检查音频、麦克风、摄像头和网络，参与者与主持人的检查不同。应先诊断权限、连接及获批准网络访问，不能把参与者无法进入直接当产品可用性发现。

sections.en: A dedicated pricing request timed out and the current UserZoom plan URL returned 403. The readable method guide establishes named plan eligibility, not their prices or current new-customer sale terms. Cash amount, cadence, research credits, recruitment/incentives, seats and renewal remain unknown; no UserTesting rate is substituted. Obtain a UserZoom-specific proposal before purchase. Source licensing, hosting options, contractual retention and recovery also need confirmation.
sections.zh: 专属价格请求超时，当前 UserZoom 套餐 URL 返回 403。可读方法指南只能确认具名套餐适用性，不能确认价格或新客户采购条件。金额、周期、研究 credits、招募激励、席位和续费均未知，不套用 UserTesting 费率。采购前需取得 UserZoom 专属方案，源码许可、托管、合同保留及恢复也待确认。
